title: Handling of congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane

entities.name: Congestion control for transport of user data via control plane
entities.description: Network-initiated congestion control mechanism for user data transport via control plane. The network can activate this control and provide a back-off timer T3448 to UEs.

entities.name: Control plane data back-off timer T3448
entities.description: Timer started by UE when network includes T3448 value in REGISTRATION ACCEPT, SERVICE ACCEPT or SERVICE REJECT message. Prevents UE from initiating user data transport via control plane while running.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message that can contain T3448 value IE to start the timer or be sent without T3448 to stop the timer.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message that can contain T3448 value IE to start the timer or be sent without T3448 to stop the timer.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: NAS message that can contain T3448 value IE to start the timer.

entities.name: T3448 value
entities.description: Information element containing the timer value for control plane data back-off timer T3448.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: 5GMM idle state where UE does not initiate user data transport via control plane while T3448 is running, except for allowed exceptions.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: UE state that causes stopping of timer T3448 when entered.

entities.name: Timer T3448 running
entities.description: Condition where timer T3448 is active, restricting UE from initiating user data transport via control plane.

entities.name: Exception data reporting allowed
entities.description: Condition where UE is allowed to send user data via control plane even when T3448 is running, for exceptional events.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message that UE can send for emergency services or to respond to paging without uplink data even when T3448 is running.

entities.name: Stop timer T3448
entities.description: Behavior where UE stops timer T3448 upon entering 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state, switching to non-equivalent PLMN, or being switched off.

relations.description: Network activation of congestion control includes starting timer T3448 in UE via messages containing T3448 value IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message can contain T3448 value IE to start the timer.
SERVICE ACCEPT message can contain T3448 value IE to start the timer.
SERVICE REJECT message can contain T3448 value IE to start the timer.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message sent without T3448 value IE stops timer T3448.
SERVICE ACCEPT message sent without T3448 value IE stops timer T3448.
When T3448 is running, UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode does not initiate user data transport via control plane.
Exception data reporting condition allows UE to send user data via control plane even when T3448 is running.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST can be sent for emergency services or paging response even when T3448 is running.
Entering 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes the property of stopping timer T3448.
